title: Coordinated sequestration and transcriptional regulation drive CSP2-mediated chlorpyrifos resistance in Nilaparvata lugens.
authors: Xu, Xiyue; Deng, Mengqing; Yang, Zhiming; Lu, Kai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褐飞虱CSP2蛋白与杀虫剂结合及FoxO转录因子调控机制，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合和转录因子调控，但核心是昆虫抗药性而非TF-DNA互作建模，且方法以实验为主，仅用分子对接，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Insecticide resistance in the brown planthopper, Nilaparvata lugens, poses a major threat to rice production. Beyond metabolic detoxification, sequestration by chemosensory proteins (CSPs) has emerged as a vital resistance mechanism. Our earlier work identified CSP2 as a contributor to chlorpyrifos resistance. However, the molecular basis of its insecticide binding and the transcriptional regulation governing its overexpression remained elusive. RESULTS: This study demonstrates that CSP2 confers resistance by functioning as a broad-spectrum scavenger, binding with high affinity to both chlorpyrifos (inhibition constant, K(i) = 3.36 +/- 0.17 mum) and its more toxic oxidative metabolite, chlorpyrifos-oxon (K(i) = 5.40 +/- 0.27 mum). Integrated molecular docking, site-directed mutagenesis, and fluorescence competitive binding assays identified distinct binding sites. Lys20 and Asp51 were essential for chlorpyrifos recognition, whereas Asp25 was critical for interacting with chlorpyrifos-oxon. Mutations in these residues severely impaired the protective function of CSP2. Furthermore, we uncovered a key transcriptional mechanism: the transcription factor FoxO acts as a transcriptional repressor of CSP2. Dual-luciferase reporter assays showed FoxO suppresses promoter activity by 34.31%, and RNA interference knockdown of FoxO led to significant upregulation of CSP2 expression and decreased susceptibility of N. lugens to chlorpyrifos. This derepression, resulting from FoxO downregulation in the resistant strain, underpins CSP2 overexpression. CONCLUSION: Our findings reveal a sophisticated, multi-layered resistance strategy in N. lugens. CSP2 provides a frontline, sequestration-based defense that complements the previously characterized CYP6BD12-inhibition mechanism of CSP15. The functional differentiation between these CSPs, coupled with the novel FoxO-mediated regulatory pathway for CSP2, illustrates a complex adaptive network. (c) 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
abstract_zh: 背景：褐飞虱（Nilaparvata lugens）对杀虫剂的抗性对水稻生产构成重大威胁。除代谢解毒外，化学感受蛋白（CSPs）的隔离作用已成为一种重要的抗性机制。我们此前的研究将CSP2鉴定为氯吡硫磷抗性的贡献因子。然而，其杀虫剂结合的分子基础及调控其过表达的转录调控机制仍不清楚。结果：本研究表明，CSP2通过作为广谱清除剂发挥作用，以高亲和力结合氯吡硫磷（抑制常数，K(i) = 3.36 ± 0.17 μm）及其毒性更强的氧化代谢物氯吡硫磷-氧磷（K(i) = 5.40 ± 0.27 μm），从而赋予抗性。整合分子对接、定点突变和荧光竞争结合实验，鉴定出不同的结合位点。Lys20和Asp51对氯吡硫磷识别至关重要，而Asp25对与氯吡硫磷-氧磷的相互作用至关重要。这些残基的突变严重损害了CSP2的保护功能。此外，我们揭示了一个关键的转录机制：转录因子FoxO作为CSP2的转录抑制因子。双荧光素酶报告实验显示，FoxO将启动子活性抑制34.31%，而RNA干扰敲低FoxO导致CSP2表达显著上调，并降低褐飞虱对氯吡硫磷的敏感性。这种由抗性品系中FoxO下调引起的去抑制，支撑了CSP2的过表达。结论：我们的发现揭示了褐飞虱中一种复杂、多层次的抗性策略。CSP2提供了一种基于隔离的前线防御，补充了先前表征的CSP15的CYP6BD12抑制机制。这些CSP之间的功能分化，加上新型FoxO介导的CSP2调控通路，展示了一个复杂的适应网络。（c）2026 化学工业学会。
